title: TokenStore
description: All minted tokens, including revoked and expired ones until pruned.

token_id.title: TokenId
token_id.description: Public identifier of a token, embedded in the token string.

kind.title: TokenKind
kind.description: session: human API; agent: agent API; worker: worker upload API.

created_at.title: Timestamp
created_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with a `Z` suffix and optional fractional seconds.

expires_at.title: Timestamp
expires_at.description: Absent for worker tokens until the job is terminal.

revoked_at.title: Timestamp
revoked_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with a `Z` suffix and optional fractional seconds.

scope.title: TokenScope
scope.description: What a token is bound to. Agent: a project (ADR 0039); worker: project, job and attempt.

project_id.title: ProjectId
project_id.description: Stable project identifier (lowercase slug). Never a path; paths live in the local registry.

attempt_id.title: AttemptId
attempt_id.description: Identifier of one attempt of a job.

purpose.description: Worker tokens only. `launch`: held by a remote worker for the whole job; it can only perform the handshake, which issues short-lived `upload` tokens (ADR 0023). Absent means `upload`.

executive_session.title: ExecutiveSessionInfo
executive_session.description: A human-API session minted for `ablationkit executive` (ADR 0064): an agent on the researcher's machine overseeing the research and running the agents. It may read and may only make the writes an executive makes (agent containers, agent sessions, directions); every other write is refused.

agent_session.title: AgentSessionInfo
agent_session.description: Agent tokens minted for an agent session (ADR 0040). Absent on agent tokens minted before it.

harness.description: The agent harness, as `ablationkit mcp` reports it (e.g. claude-code, codex).

last_used_at.title: Timestamp
last_used_at.description: Updated at most once a minute while the agent calls the API.

idle_timeout_sec.description: The session ends after this long without a request.

container_session.title: ContainerSessionId
container_session.description: Set when the session runs in an agent container (ADR 0061): the coordinator minted the token for the container, its jobs run in job containers, and the container is its boundary.
